capabilities: Edit table cells directly in Live Preview and Reading view
Resize columns, merge cells and reorder rows or columns
Color cells, rows and columns and apply table styles
Add calculated columns, total rows and column types
Paste spreadsheet or HTML tables and copy tables with formatting
extras: Diagnostics are desktop-only and stored outside the vault; encrypted columns use a master password that cannot be recovered if lost. The README also points to a website and a SKILL.md for AI-assisted table writing.
intentEvidence: turn off to go back to Obsidian's own tables
problem: Obsidian's built-in Markdown tables are plain text and lack visual cell editing, colors, column resizing, merges and calculated columns.

relations.evidence: same format as Meld Encrypt's inline encryption, so either can decrypt it
An Advanced Tables formula comment (<!-- TBLFM -->) or a block id (^id) under a table is kept as is
exporting a note to an image with the Export Image plugin, tables look the same
when Find in file, global search or Omnisearch jumps into a table
gogoga Mind Map and gogoga Table share the same records and switches.

summary: Notion-style Markdown table editor with click-to-edit cells, colors, resizing, merges, formulas and column types.
